verdict.rationale: Langfuse's docs describe a managed LLM-as-a-judge evaluator that automatically scores live production traces and can run on a sample of traffic. Judge scores can be numeric, categorical, or boolean. Engineering guides show the evaluator applied to hallucination detection and RAG faithfulness, both in offline experiments and on production traces. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of judge configuration (custom judge prompts, model selection, variable mapping), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the evaluators work as described.
